Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a Discogs release credit, treating “Written-By – Hank Williams” (which applies to the B-side track “Cold Cold Heart”) as the songwriter credit for the A-side “Turn Me On.” This conflated the B-side’s writer with the A-side’s, ignoring prior, correct evidence that “Turn Me On” was written by John D. Loudermilk and failing to cross-verify before concluding.
